gaps.title: Bootstrap 95% CI on ROC-AUC
gaps.method: Resample 80% of cells per publication with replacement, retrain a fast gradient-boosted surrogate on 3 publications, evaluate on the held-out publication, 250 iterations per fold x 4 folds (1000 total iterations).

gaps.title: Kuroda 3-gene threshold head-to-head
gaps.method: Kuroda score = ESRG + CNMD + SFRP2 expression; threshold = 25th percentile of positive-class training scores. Both methods evaluated on identical 4-fold leave-one-site-out splits; DeLong z-test on paired ROC curves.

gaps.title: Ablation study (6 configurations)
gaps.method: Each component combination evaluated on a held-out publication.

gaps.title: Harmony batch correction (FP rate before vs after)
gaps.method: PCA(30) on combined train+test; Harmony (harmonypy) removes batch structure; logistic regression retrained on corrected embeddings; false-positive rate on negative cells of the held-out site compared before vs after.

gaps.title: Multi-seed reproducibility
gaps.method: Full ensemble retrained with seeds 42/123/456/789/1024 on identical data splits.
